title: 矿产品采购三方对账与付款审批控制
english: Three-way reconciliation and controlled payment approval

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 4分钟：每句慢读两遍，注意 reconciliation、authorization 的重音。
lines: reconcile the ledger
核对台账
documentary evidence
书面证据
authorized signatory
授权签字人
beneficial ownership
实际受益所有权
payment instruction
付款指令
invoice discrepancy
发票差异
shipment readiness
货物发运准备状态
conditional approval
附条件批准

modules.title: 10个核心句
modules.hint: 7分钟：先跟读，再遮住英文复述。
lines: We need to reconcile the purchase order, goods receipt and invoice before payment.
付款前必须核对采购订单、收货记录和发票。
The quantity variance must be explained in writing.
数量差异必须以书面方式说明。
Please provide the original supporting voucher.
请提供原始支持凭证。
The invoice cannot be approved while the beneficiary remains unverified.
收款受益人未经核实，发票不能获批。
A credit note may be required to correct the overcharge.
可能需要贷项通知单来纠正多收费。
The disputed amount will remain on hold pending review.
争议金额将在复核期间暂停支付。
We can release the undisputed balance after normal approval.
正常审批后可以支付无争议余额。
Please confirm the final dry weight and assay basis.
请确认最终干重和化验计价依据。
The export documents must reflect the actual shipment.
出口单证必须反映实际发运情况。
I will record the exception and escalate it to the authorized manager.
我将登记异常并上报授权经理。

modules.title: 金额、吨位、品位、汇率口述
modules.hint: 6分钟：所有数字为练习假设，先读数字，再口头复算。
lines: For this exercise, the gross weight is twelve point six metric tonnes.
本练习假设毛重为12.6公吨。
Assume moisture is four percent, giving a dry weight of twelve point zero nine six tonnes.
假设水分4%，则干重为12.096吨。
Assume the assay is thirty-two point five percent tantalum pentoxide.
假设五氧化二钽品位为32.5%。
The hypothetical unit price is one hundred and eighty dollars per dry tonne.
假设单价为每干吨180美元。
The illustrative invoice amount is two thousand one hundred seventy-seven dollars and twenty-eight cents.
示例发票金额为2,177.28美元。
At an illustrative rate of one dollar to one thousand four hundred and fifty francs, the amount is three million one hundred fifty-six thousand and fifty-six francs.
按假设汇率1美元兑1450法郎，金额为3,156,056法郎。
Please distinguish gross weight from dry weight.
请区分毛重和干重。
Please read back the amount and currency before approval.
审批前请复述金额和币种。

modules.title: Shadowing跟读
modules.hint: 5分钟：连续跟读三轮，最后脱稿录音。
lines: Our team has received the invoice, but the supporting documents are incomplete.
我们已收到发票，但支持文件不完整。
We will reconcile the weight, grade and agreed pricing basis.
我们将核对重量、品位和约定计价依据。
Any discrepancy must be supported by original records.
任何差异都必须有原始记录支持。
The verified portion may proceed through the normal approval workflow.
已核实部分可按正常审批流程处理。
We cannot bypass beneficiary verification to meet a deadline.
我们不能为赶截止时间而绕过收款人核验。
Please send the corrected documents before the next review meeting.
请在下次复核会议前发送更正后的单证。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 4分钟：两人交替扮演，保持礼貌且不作付款承诺。
lines: Good morning. Was the journey to the warehouse smooth?
早上好，去仓库的路顺利吗？
Yes, thank you. Traffic was lighter than expected.
顺利，谢谢，交通比预想通畅。
How is your team managing the end-of-month workload?
你们团队如何应对月底工作量？
We are prioritizing reconciliations and export documentation.
我们正优先处理对账和出口单证。
I appreciate you making time for this review.
感谢你抽时间参加本次复核。
Shall we begin with the items that both sides agree on?
我们先从双方一致认可的项目开始好吗？

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 6分钟：按买方、供应商、财务三方轮流表达。
lines: Supplier: Our invoice reflects the delivered ore, so please pay today.
供应商：我们的发票反映已交付矿石，请今天付款。
Buyer: The receiving ticket shows a different net weight.
买方：收货单显示的净重不同。
Supplier: The difference may be due to moisture at unloading.
供应商：差异可能由卸货时水分造成。
Buyer: Let us compare the original weighing and moisture records.
买方：我们核对原始称重和水分记录。
Finance: The price formula must match the signed purchase agreement.
财务：计价公式必须符合已签采购协议。
Supplier: Can you pay the portion that is not disputed?
供应商：能否先付无争议部分？
Finance: Yes, subject to documented reconciliation and approval.
财务：可以，但须完成书面对账和审批。
Buyer: We will issue a joint discrepancy report today.
买方：我们今天出具联合差异报告。

modules.title: 运输押运与海关
modules.hint: 5分钟：练习货物状态与单证状态分开表达。
lines: The truck is parked in the designated secure area.
卡车停在指定安全区域。
The escort officer has signed the handover log.
押运人员已签署交接日志。
Please check the seal number against the dispatch record.
请将封签号与发运记录核对。
The customs declaration must match the actual cargo description.
海关申报必须与实际货物描述一致。
Do not amend the invoice merely to accelerate clearance.
不要仅为加快清关而修改发票。
The certificate of origin must be supported by authentic records.
原产地证明必须有真实记录支持。
We will release the vehicle only after authorized clearance.
只有获得授权放行后才安排车辆离开。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟：三轮各5分钟，先即兴回答，再朗读示范，最后复述。
lines: Decision one: The supplier demands full payment before the weight discrepancy is resolved.
决策一：供应商要求在重量差异解决前全额付款。
Supplier: If you do not pay now, we will stop future deliveries.
供应商：现在不付款，我们将停止后续供货。
Model answer: I understand your concern, but we cannot approve the disputed portion without reconciliation. We can review the undisputed amount today.
示范回答：我理解贵方担忧，但未经对账不能批准争议部分。我们今天可以复核无争议金额。
Decision two: A manager asks you to pay a new beneficiary account immediately.
决策二：经理要求立即付款到新收款账户。
Manager: The director approved this verbally. Process it now.
经理：董事口头批准了，马上处理。
Model answer: I can prioritize the request, but the new beneficiary must pass independent verification and the required approval controls first.
示范回答：我可以优先处理，但新收款人必须先通过独立核验和必要审批。
Decision three: A forwarding agent suggests changing the export invoice to match an outdated declaration.
决策三：货代建议修改出口发票以匹配过期申报。
Agent: Just change the invoice date so the truck can cross today.
货代：把发票日期改一下，车今天就能过境。
Model answer: We cannot backdate or misstate documents. Please initiate a legitimate correction and provide the updated customs reference.
示范回答：我们不能倒签或虚假填写单证。请按合法程序更正并提供更新后的海关编号。
Follow-up: What can you release immediately without violating controls?
追问：不违反控制要求的情况下，哪些事项可以立即放行？
Model answer: We can release verified information and approved undisputed payments, but not unverified funds or incorrectly documented cargo.
示范回答：我们可以放行已核实信息和已批准的无争议付款，但不能放行未经核实的资金或单证错误的货物。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 4分钟：遮住英文，让同伴朗读或使用点读，再核对拼写。
lines: The payment remains pending until the invoice discrepancy is resolved.
发票差异解决前付款保持待处理。
Please attach the signed reconciliation statement.
请附上已签署的对账说明。
The revised weight must be supported by the original scale ticket.
修订重量必须有原始磅单支持。
We need written confirmation from the authorized signatory.
我们需要授权签字人的书面确认。
Customs clearance is separate from payment approval.
海关放行与付款审批是两个独立事项。

modules.title: 5道口语题
lines: Question: How would you explain a disputed invoice to a supplier?
问题：你如何向供应商解释争议发票？
Model: I would identify the disputed line items, request original evidence and agree on a review deadline.
示范：我会指出争议明细，索取原始证据并约定复核期限。
Question: What would you check before approving a payment?
问题：付款审批前你会检查什么？
Model: I would check the contract, receipt, invoice, beneficiary and authorization.
示范：我会检查合同、收货、发票、收款人和授权。
Question: Can a verbal instruction replace KYC?
问题：口头指示能代替KYC吗？
Model: No. Required verification must be documented before the transfer.
示范：不能，转账前必须完成并记录必要核验。
Question: What should you do if customs documents conflict?
问题：海关单证相互矛盾怎么办？
Model: Hold the affected release and request a legitimate documented correction.
示范：暂停受影响的放行，要求合法且有记录的更正。
Question: How would you negotiate an undisputed partial payment?
问题：你如何协商支付无争议部分？
Model: I would separate the amounts, confirm the basis and obtain normal approval.
示范：我会拆分金额、确认依据并取得正常审批。

modules.title: 近期三课复习
modules.english: Review of the previous three lessons
modules.hint: 3分钟：复习取样、批次证据链和对账控制。
lines: A retained sample protects both parties in an assay dispute.
留存样在化验争议中保护双方。
A seal discrepancy requires a documented investigation.
封签差异需要形成书面调查记录。
A beneficiary change triggers renewed verification.
收款人变更触发重新核验。
A signed reconciliation supports an accurate settlement.
已签对账单支持准确结算。
A genuine correction is different from backdating.
真实更正不同于倒签日期。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 4分钟：连读整段，第二轮不看英文，第三轮模拟向主管汇报。
lines: Good morning. I am reporting on the reconciliation status of a hypothetical mineral purchase.
早上好，我汇报一笔假设矿产品采购的对账状态。
We have received the goods and invoice, but the recorded net weights do not fully agree.
我们已收到货物和发票，但记录净重尚未完全一致。
Our team is checking the original scale tickets, moisture adjustment and assay basis.
团队正在核查原始磅单、水分调整及化验计价依据。
The undisputed amount may move forward after the standard approval checks.
无争议金额可在标准审批后继续处理。
The disputed balance will remain on hold until both parties sign the reconciliation.
争议余额将在双方签署对账单前继续暂停支付。
We are also independently verifying the beneficiary before any transfer.
任何转账前我们还将独立核验收款人。
The logistics team is checking seal records, escort logs and export documents.
物流团队正在核查封签记录、押运日志和出口文件。
We will not change historical records merely to meet a shipping deadline.
我们不会仅为赶发运期限而修改历史记录。
I will report unresolved exceptions to the authorized manager and confirm the next review time in writing.
我将向授权经理报告未解决异常，并书面确认下次复核时间。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 2分钟：逐项口头确认，不会的句子回到对应模块。
lines: I can explain the three-way reconciliation process in English.
我能用英语解释三方对账流程。
I can read the hypothetical weights, grades and exchange rates accurately.
我能准确读出假设重量、品位和汇率。
I can reject an unverified beneficiary change politely.
我能礼貌拒绝未经核实的收款人变更。
I can describe the difference between customs clearance and payment approval.
我能解释海关放行与付款审批的区别。
I completed three timed pressure decisions and five dictation sentences.
我已完成三轮限时高压决策和五句听写。
I can deliver the full workplace briefing without reading the script.
我能脱稿完成整段工作汇报。
